content:
# Disagreement Log — 1QM Column 4

| # | Line | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Category | Resolution |
|---|------|------|-------|--------|----------|------------|
| 1 | 4:1 | "Thousands-of God" | "Thousands of God" | "God's Thousands" | Inscription form | SOPHIA: "Thousands of God" — maintains "of God" construct per Col. 3 precedent |
| 2 | 4:2 | "the full order-of its names" | "the full order of its names" | "the complete roster of names" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "the full order of its names" — LOGOS; "roster" (PNEUMA) too modern |
| 3 | 4:3 | "Wrath-of God" | "Wrath of God" | "God's Wrath" | Inscription form | SOPHIA: "Wrath of God" — consistent construct form |
| 4 | 4:6 | "Thanksgivings-to God" | "Thanksgivings to God" | "Thanks to God" | Inscription | SOPHIA: "Thanksgivings to God" — preserves Hebrew plural todot |
| 5 | 4:8 | "the Prince-of the whole congregation" | "the Prince of the whole congregation" | "the Prince of the entire congregation" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "the Prince of the whole congregation" — LOGOS; standard DSS rendering |
| 6 | 4:9 | "according-to their generations" | "according to their order of birth" | "in birth order" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "according to their order of birth" — LOGOS clarifies toledot in context |
| 7 | 4:10 | "when their army is-complete" | "when their army is at full strength" | "when the army is at full strength" | Structural | SOPHIA: "when their army is at full strength" — LOGOS/PNEUMA phrasing clearer |
| 8 | 4:11 | "the masters-of the sling-stones" | "the sling masters" | "the sling experts" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "the sling masters" — LOGOS concise; EMET's compound too cumbersome |
| 9 | 4:13 | "the dagger-of war upon-it" | "a war dagger mounted on it" | "each fitted with a combat dagger" | Structural | SOPHIA: "a war dagger mounted on it" — LOGOS clear and formal |
| 10 | 4:14 | "shall surround-them on-their-two-sides" | "shall flank them on both sides" | "will guard both sides" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "shall guard them on both sides" — blends LOGOS structure with PNEUMA verb |
| 11 | 4:15 | "three-hundred shields" | "three hundred shields in all" | "three hundred shields total" | Addition | SOPHIA: "three hundred shields in all" — LOGOS; clarifying "in all" useful |
| 12 | 4:15 | "the tower shall-go-out" | "the tower shall advance" | "The tower will advance" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "the tower shall advance" — LOGOS; "advance" better than "go out" for military |
| 13 | 4:16 | "the men-of battle" | "warriors" | "fighters" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "warriors" — LOGOS; PNEUMA too casual; EMET too wordy |
| 14 | 4:17 | "foot-soldiers" | "infantry" | "foot soldiers" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "infantry" — LOGOS; standard military English |

**Total disagreements: 14**
